text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly adding to Stock A as its price rose increased my exposure; I’ll set position limits and keep my portfolio diversified.","Selling Stock C after a steep fall locked in a large loss; I’ll decide in advance what would justify selling rather than reacting to a drop alone.","A few months of account gains or losses don’t show whether my approach is working; I’ll review performance over longer periods and keep investing consistently toward my apartment goal."]}
